title: Binary Phase Retrieval of Cosine Transforms via Local Curvature Minimization
title_zh: 通过局部曲率最小化的余弦变换二值相位检索

paragraphs.en: Cosine transforms see frequent use in image and video compression due to their ease of computation and high energy compaction. This has sparked interest within the optics community in computing cosine transforms optically for compression. When imaging in the Fourier plane to capture a cosine transform, one encounters a phase retrieval problem: optical fields have both magnitude and phase, but cameras only capture the magnitude of the field. Cosine transforms restrict the phase retrieval problem to a binary domain as opposed to the unit circle, but general phase retrieval solutions do not leverage this. In this work, we demonstrate that sign errors in phase retrieval for cosine transforms result in a significant increase in the magnitude of the Hessian of the transform at the error. Motivated by this, we develop an algorithm to solve this binary phase retrieval problem by minimizing the curvature of the reconstructed cosine transform. We demonstrate via computational experiments that given the magnitude of the cosine transform of an image, we can consistently reconstruct the original image within a multiscale structural similarity index of 0.95. We show that the solve time grows approximately linearly with the number of pixels solved.

paragraphs.en: Fourier transforms have a plethora of applications in optics and signal processing, including compression. However, the closely related cosine transform sees significantly more use in image and video compression. For example, discrete cosine transforms (DCT) are used in the JPEG standard for image compression and the MPEG and H.261 standards for video compression [ 20 ] . Cosine transforms have become widely adopted due to their ease of computation (they can be computed as simply as the Fourier transform) as well as their energy compaction properties (having performance very similar to that of the optimal Karhunen-Loéve transform) [ 1 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 傅里叶变换在光学和信号处理领域有大量应用，包括压缩。 然而，与之密切相关的余弦变换在图像和视频压缩中得到了更为广泛的使用。 例如，离散余弦变换（DCT）被用于图像压缩的 JPEG 标准以及视频压缩的 MPEG 和 H.261 标准 [ 20 ] 。 余弦变换之所以被广泛采用，是因为其计算简便（可以像傅里叶变换一样轻松计算），以及其能量压缩特性（性能与最优的 Karhunen-Loéve 变换非常接近） [ 1 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Optical sensing devices typically capture the magnitude of an optical field, but not the phase, which is essential information in most applications, including those above. Except for [ 9 ] , each of these applications propose a beam-flooding technique for phase retrieval. There, a reference beam is superimposed on the optical cosine transform such that the resulting field is converted from a real-valued field to a nonnegative-valued field. If one has an image of the reference beam, an image of the standalone cosine transform and the image of the superposition, one can theoretically retrieve the phase of the cosine transform. However, the beam-flooding method relies on precise alignment to achieve interference sufficiently accurate to perform effective phase retrieval. This practically results in performance that is not robust to misalignment and other implementation errors, necessitating other more mature phase retrieval solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 光学传感装置通常只能捕捉光场的幅值，而无法捕捉相位，而相位在包括上述应用在内的大多数应用中都是至关重要的信息。 除文献[9]外，上述每种应用都提出了一种光束泛光照明技术来进行相位恢复。 在该方法中，参考光束被叠加到光学余弦变换上，使合成后的光场从实值场转换为非负值场。 如果拥有参考光束的图像、独立余弦变换的图像以及两者叠加后的图像，理论上就可以恢复出余弦变换的相位。 然而，光束泛光照明方法依赖于精确对准，以实现足够精确的干涉来完成有效的相位恢复。 这实际上导致其性能对失准及其他实现误差不具鲁棒性，因此需要其他更成熟的相位恢复解决方案。

paragraphs.en: While the Fourier transform of a real-valued function can be complex-valued, the cosine transform of a real-valued function must be real-valued, allowing one to restrict the phase retrieval problem in the latter case to a binary domain as opposed to the full complex torus. State-of-the-art phase retrieval solutions cannot leverage this principle when applied to cosine transforms. In the context of image/video compression, the strong energy compaction of cosine transforms allows one to devote computational resources more efficiently during phase retrieval, focusing efforts in higher energy regions of the frequency domain. In this work, we leverage these advantages to develop a binary phase retrieval algorithm for cosine transforms of images. Fig. 1 depicts a block diagram of the binary phase recovery workflow.

paragraphs.en: Our objective is to recover an image given the magnitude of its cosine transform. In order for this to be possible, we must have that the magnitude of an image’s cosine transform is unique to that image. Herein, we shall consider an “image” to be a function f : ℝ 2 ↦ ℝ f:\mathbb{R}^{2}\mapsto\mathbb{R} that is nonnegative, integrable and has compact support. One can always shift an image so that its support lies in ℝ ≥ 0 2 \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}^{2} and then reflect the resulting function about each axis to produce an even function. The Fourier transform of the resulting function must be equivalent to its cosine transform. Given this definition, the intensity of the cosine transform of an image is unique. We state this property formally below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是从图像的余弦变换幅值恢复该图像。 为了使这一点成为可能，我们必须有：图像的余弦变换幅值对该图像是唯一的。 本文将“图像”视为一个非负、可积且具有紧支撑的函数 f : ℝ² ↦ ℝ f:\mathbb{R}^{2}\mapsto\mathbb{R}。 总可以平移一幅图像，使其支撑位于 ℝ≥0² \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}^{2} 中，然后将所得函数关于每个坐标轴作反射，从而得到一个偶函数。 所得函数的傅里叶变换必定等价于其余弦变换。 在此定义下，图像余弦变换的强度是唯一的。 我们在下面正式陈述这一性质。

sents.zh: 为了使这一点成为可能，我们必须有：图像的余弦变换幅值对该图像是唯一的。

sents.en: Herein, we shall consider an “image” to be a function f : ℝ 2 ↦ ℝ f:\mathbb{R}^{2}\mapsto\mathbb{R} that is nonnegative, integrable and has compact support.
sents.zh: 本文将“图像”视为一个非负、可积且具有紧支撑的函数 f : ℝ² ↦ ℝ f:\mathbb{R}^{2}\mapsto\mathbb{R}。

sents.en: One can always shift an image so that its support lies in ℝ ≥ 0 2 \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}^{2} and then reflect the resulting function about each axis to produce an even function.
sents.zh: 总可以平移一幅图像，使其支撑位于 ℝ≥0² \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}^{2} 中，然后将所得函数关于每个坐标轴作反射，从而得到一个偶函数。

sents.en: The Fourier transform of the resulting function must be equivalent to its cosine transform.
sents.zh: 所得函数的傅里叶变换必定等价于其余弦变换。

sents.en: Given this definition, the intensity of the cosine transform of an image is unique.
sents.zh: 在此定义下，图像余弦变换的强度是唯一的。

sents.en: We state this property formally below.
sents.zh: 我们在下面正式陈述这一性质。

paragraphs.en: In order to solve for the sign of an individual block, 𝗀 i , j {\mathsf{g}}^{i,j} , the block along with its bordering pixels are fed to the QUBO formulated in Section II-D to solve for their sign. Let 𝗀 β i , j {\mathsf{g}}^{i,j}_{\beta} denote the block augmented with a border of width β \beta , that is, the array consisting of rows ( i − 1 ) ​ m ′ + 1 − β (i-1){m^{\prime}}+1-\beta to i ​ m ′ + β i{m^{\prime}}+\beta and columns ( j − 1 ) ​ n ′ + 1 − β (j-1){n^{\prime}}+1-\beta to j ​ n ′ + β j{n^{\prime}}+\beta of 𝗀 \mathsf{g} . Applying the procedure in Section II-D to 𝗀 β i , j {\mathsf{g}}^{i,j}_{\beta} will yield an output, 𝗌 ~ β i , j ∈ { − 1 , 1 } ( m ′ + β ) × ( n ′ + β ) {\tilde{\mathsf{s}}}^{i,j}_{\beta}\in\{-1,1\}^{({m^{\prime}}+\beta)\times({n^{\prime}}+\beta)} . Trimming the first β \beta and last β \beta rows and columns of 𝗌 ~ β i , j {\tilde{\mathsf{s}}}^{i,j}_{\beta} yields 𝗌 ~ i , j ∈ { − 1 , 1 } m ′ × n ′ {\tilde{\mathsf{s}}}^{i,j}\in\{-1,1\}^{{m^{\prime}}\times{n^{\prime}}} , the interim sign solution for the individual block. While we ultimately discard the solution for the sign of the border pixels, passing border pixels to the QUBO solver enables it to more accurately compute the Hessian and solve for the correct sign near the edge of a block. The width of the border β \beta can be tuned to achieve the desired performance from the solver. Increasing β \beta improves the accuracy of the solver at the cost of a solve time that grows exponentially with β \beta . Same padding is used whenever the border extends beyond the domain of the image.

paragraphs.en: The performance of Algorithm 1 was measured by testing it on the DCT magnitude of images in the Kodak Lossless True Color Image Suite [ 6 ] . This dataset consists of 24 images of size 768 × 512 768\times 512 or 512 × 768 512\times 768 . Fig. 1 depicts the experimental pipeline for a single image. We compute the magnitude of the DCT of an image before feeding it to Algorithm 1 . The resulting sign solution is applied to the DCT magnitude function to compute the reconstruction of the DCT. We take the inverse DCT of the result to compute the reconstructed image. As noted briefly in Section II-C , our motivation for Hessian norm minimization as a means to recover binary phase applies to the discrete case only if the DCT used has a sufficiently small sampling interval. We can create an arbitrarily small DCT sampling interval by padding the original image with zeros before taking the DCT.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 depicts the neighbor similarity score that results from running Algorithm 1 on DCTs constructed from each image in the data set given some padding m p = n p m_{p}=n_{p} that was varied from 0 to 3000 in increments of 300. For this experiment, we set α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 , β = 1 \beta=1 and m ′ = n ′ = 6 {m^{\prime}}={n^{\prime}}=6 . paragraphs.en: In this work, we motivated and designed an algorithm that retrieves phase for the cosine transform of images by minimizing the curvature of the reconstructed transform. Unlike general phase retrieval algorithms, our algorithm leverages the energy compaction of cosine transforms and their restricted phase domain. We demonstrated that the algorithm can consistently reconstruct images to within an MSSSIM of 0.95.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们论证并设计了一种算法，该算法通过最小化重建变换的曲率来检索图像余弦变换的相位。 与一般的相位检索算法不同，我们的算法利用了余弦变换的能量集中特性及其受限的相位域。 我们证明了该算法能够稳定地重建图像，MSSSIM 达到 0.95 以内。

sents.zh: 与一般的相位检索算法不同，我们的算法利用了余弦变换的能量集中特性及其受限的相位域。

sents.en: We demonstrated that the algorithm can consistently reconstruct images to within an MSSSIM of 0.95.
sents.zh: 我们证明了该算法能够稳定地重建图像，MSSSIM 达到 0.95 以内。

paragraphs.en: While this algorithm functions well on computationally computed cosine transforms, it does not yet perform well on optically generated cosine transforms. Misalignment, ambient light, vibration and other factors present within a lab environment can introduce “noise” into the cosine transform of an image, causing it to violate the motivation discussed in Section II-B . In particular, the sharp curvature present along the zero level set of an image of an ideal cosine transform can become fairly smooth when non-ideal factors are introduced. Future work will explore how to make our algorithm robust to such issues.

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 functions by decomposing a cosine transform into blocks, solving each block independently and then resolving sign discrepancies between each block. The subproblems are coupled together through the parameter β \beta as well as the inter-block curvature. However, there is no guarantee that Algorithm 1 converges to a global optimum of ( 19 ). Another direction for future work would involve employing an optimization technique that synergizes well with the divide-and-conquer nature of Algorithm 1 while guaranteeing optimality, such as the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). However, the iterative nature of ADMM may result in longer solve times.
